en:
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>toilet paper<CLT=cltNORMAL> we
found outside the mansion...

That's what the culprit used to get
from the roof to the ground!
The...toilet paper?

The same toilet paper that was
used as the murder weapon.

That's why we didn't find it
anywhere else.

Not at the scene of the crime,
nor on Miu's body.
It was outside the mansion.

Hold on... If they used the toilet paper
as a rope to get down from the roof...

Then they'd need to tie it to something.
But there was nothing to tie it to.
I know because...I investigated the roof!

You're stubborn, Kaito.
You're still going on about this...

Of course I am! I'm gonna believe 
in Gonta till the very end!

No, there was something that the
toilet paper could have been tied to.
Wh-What!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, the place where the
toilet paper was tied down...
...There.

Huuuh!?
What do you mean, there?

Shuichi!
It seems like you have no idea, but...

...there is something, right?
Like...some kind of pole?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The roof door's doorknob.

It was tied that far away!?
Quit screwin' around, man!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

If they tied it around the door
of the storage room...

The storage room had a sliding door! 
There's no way they coulda used that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>...No,
it's because this toilet paper was tied...

Heh, you get it now!? There wasn't 
anywhere to tie the toilet paper!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There wasn't anywhere they could tie
the toilet paper! I believe in Gonta!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Where did the culprit tie the
toilet paper to get down from the roof?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>binoculars<CLT=cltNORMAL> on the rooftop.
The toilet paper could have been tied there.

However, I don't think the culprit actually
tied it down there. They just hung it...

...and then used the doubled-up toilet paper
to climb down.

But in that case, they would have had
to tug on it in order to take it down...

Yup, that's correct!
Cuz I came up with that idea!
R-Really...?

But I thought I told Gonta to put the
toilet paper back in the bathroom...

Oh! I guess he ran into someone on the 
way, and then threw it somewhere close by.

Nee-heehee... Looks like Kaito's morale is
shot, so this whole thing is done now!
The matter...does appear to be settled.
Th-That... It's...
So...it true. Gonta...really kill Miu.

But I'm the one who came up with the plan!
Anywaaay...just admit your crime, Gonta.

Even though you don't remember...
you still did it.

B-But...why did Gonta do...such...
terrible thing...?

Wait, before you start crying...you gotta
admit your crime fir—
Stop.

I won't let you, Kokichi.
If anyone is going to get him to confess...
...it's me.

Gonta...I'm going to look back at the
whole case one more time, okay?

When you're convinced, you just let
me know, alright? Let's end this together.
Uhhhh... Uhhhhh...
O-Okay...
